body:
Went after the dominant real blocker found via the real self-compile
diagnostic run against selfhost/lexer.prn: a let-binding whose value
is a plain function call (not alloc), the exact shape lexer.prn's own
real (let [lx0 (selfhost/lexer/new-lexer src)] ...) needs, responsible
for 35 of ~57 real self-compile errors.

emit-let-bindings' 2-way alloc-call-shaped? dispatch became a real
3-way one (emit-let-value/let-value-error-prefix): a real alloc call
(unchanged), a real plain call (new), or still a clean #error for
anything else. plain-call-shaped? is deliberately narrow: not alloc,
not a vec/-qualified call (the same real, permanent collision-risk
exclusion src/emit.c's own mangle_call_name already makes -- vec is a
hardcoded runtime pseudo-module this narrow emitter has no registry
to disambiguate from a real user function), every real argument is
itself a bare symbol (no nested calls, no literals). Each argument
resolves through the same resolve-arena-ref every other arena-typed
reference already uses.

New mangle-call-name strips a /-qualified call name
(selfhost/lexer/new-lexer) down to its own real final segment
(confirmed live via grep that the full C compiler never
module-prefixes generated top-level defn names -- new_lexer, not
selfhost_lexer_new_lexer), then runs the existing hyphen-only mangle.

13 new assertions (26 total for domain 4): updated the original crash
regression fixture to a shape still deliberately unsupported (a
nested-call argument, since the original fixture is now real,
supported emission), plus new coverage for a bare plain call, a
/-qualified plain call, and the permanent vec/-qualified exclusion.
Full local suite (336 tests) + all 5 selfhost domains + real mingw
cross-compile clean, zero regressions. CI green on all 4 jobs.

Real, measured progress: selfhost/lexer.prn's own self-compile error
count dropped from 57 to 46 (#error count specifically: 35 -> 24) --
still doesn't compile. Remaining real gaps, documented in NORTHSTAR.md,
not attempted here: non-symbol call arguments, match/cond as a real
body form, and a not-yet-diagnosed undeclared-identifier class
(Region/I32/Lexer bare tokens).

PARENA commit b3d7071. CI run 33099473149: all 4 jobs green.
